description:
## 1.36.0-dev.112 (2026-08-10)

- Reddit: draw the comment selector on Reddit's exact focused node instead of the higher collapse-action ancestor.
- Reddit: retain the linked native comment action so O still collapses or expands the comment containing that focused node.
- Reddit: hide the comment selector on the three-dot More control and let O activate that control normally.
- Reddit: keep the active Compose-host and rapid-key ordering fixes from dev111.
- Reddit: leave P preview behavior unchanged.
